abīja.p:
[Na+bīja] (na) CL=9 1.Not having Seed - Seedles fruits e.g - tender things ( tender mangoes, etc.). [Vinaya Use]
2.not having genital/sexual seed [can produce male or female ] seed it didn't happen bhawa rupa [Abhidhamma]
3. not having Kamma Seed that can give new life( Suttana)
(PMED)

( i ) an origin; a source of propagation; an original state; an ore; an egg; Abh 91 (nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ … ~aṃ); 950; Ja I 294, 1´ (aṇḍaṃ vuccati ~aṃ); Sp 544, 4 (rajataṃ ca jātarūpaṃ ca … sabbena sabbaṃ ~ato paṭṭhāya anāmāsaṃ; Vjb [ Be ] 186, 24 : dhātupāsāṇato paṭṭhāya); 761, 25 (~ehi jātāni °-jātāni, rukkhādīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); 859, 34 (etaṃ suraṃ vā merayaṃ vā ~ato paṭṭhāya kusaggena pivato pi; Vmv [ Be ] II 42, 9 foll.: yathāvuttānaṃ piṭṭhādīnaṃ majjatthāya bhājane pakkhittakālato paṭṭhāya) ≠ Vv-a 73, 15 ; Ap-a 325, 9 (aṇḍaṃ ~aṃ rakkhamānā kikīsakuṇikā iva); — ifc see tambaloha-, pakkhi- ( sv pakkhi[n] ), suvaṇṇa-; — ( ii ) what is propagated; a seedling, a cutting; a growing plant; Vin IV 35, 14 (~e °-saññī chindati); M I 457, 35 (~ānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ); Ja IV 228, 23 (mahābodhito ~aṃ āharitvā Jetavanadvāre ropessāmi bhante ti); Sp 762, 16 (evaṃ ~ato sambhūto bhūtagāmo ~an ti vutto ti veditabbo); Pj II 144, 8 (~an ti pañcavidhaṃ mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phalubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījam eva pañcaman ti); — ifc see agga- ( sv agga 1 ), khandha-, phalu-, mūla-; — ( iii ) a testicle; Abh 273 (~aṃ ca phalam eva ca); 950; Ja I 281, 1 (attānaṃ paṭicca jātānaṃ vānarapotakānaṃ vuddhippattā ime yūthaṃ parihareyyun ti bhayena dantehi ḍasitvā tesaṃ ~āni uppāṭeti); Sp 1016, 5 (yassa upakkamena ~āni apanītāni ayaṃ opakkamikapaṇḍako); 1094, 4 (aṇḍaṃ phāletvā ~āni uddharitvā arogaṃ karissāmī ti); — ifc see uddhaṭa- ( sv uddharati ); — °’- uppāṭana , n. , castration; Ja VI 238, 5´ ; — °- kosa , m. [bīja + kosa 1 ], a seed-vessel (esp. the pericarp of a lotus); Abh 687 (~o tu kaṇṇikā); — °- gāma , m. [bīja + gāma 2 ], the group of seeds; the group of sources of propagation; Sp 763, 18 (tāni hi ~e saṅgahaṃ gacchanti); Sv 81, 23 (sabbaṃ h’ etaṃ rukkhato viyojitaṃ virūhanasamattham eva ~o ti vuccati); Spk III 134, 28 (pañcavidhaṃ bījaṃ ~o nāma); Paṭis-a 690, 10 (~o ti °-samūho); Vin-vn 1002 foll.; — °- nīhāra , m. , taking out, extracting, the seed; ? Nidd I 382, 7 (iminā nakkhattena ~o kattabbo, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se vījanihāro; cf Nidd-a I 416, 9 : ~o ti bījānaṃ vappatthāya bahi nīharaṇaṃ, niharo ti pi pāḷi, Be, Se so; Ce nihāro ti pi; Ee nīhāro ti pi); — °- pūra , m. , the Citron; SAF: Citrus medica L.; Abh 577 (mātuluṅgo ~o); Th-a I 99, 15 (~-phalāni satthu upanesi) = Ap-a 333, 2 ; Thī-a 214, 8 (pupphitaṃ ~-lataṃ viya); — °- bīja , n. , what is propagated from seed or stone; Vin IV 35, 11 (~aṃ nāma pubbaṇṇaṃ aparaṇṇaṃ yāni vā pan’ aññāni pi atthi bīje jāyanti bīje sañjāyanti); D I 5, 31 ; Sp 762, 10 (ambajambūpanasaṭṭhi-ādīni ~ānī ti daṭṭhabbāni); — °- miñja , n. , seed and pith; Ap 396, 21 ( Be, Ce ~am adās’ ahaṃ; Ee bījabījam; Se vījavījam; Ap-a 487, 7 foll.: vibhītakaphalāni phāletvā bījāni miñjāni gahetvā); — abīja , n. and mfn. , 1. ( n. ) not a growing plant; not something that grows; Vin IV 35, 17 (~e bījasaññī); Nidd I 434, 6 (te kammābhisaṅkhāre sosehi … ~aṃ karohi; cf Nidd-a I 435, 11 : maggañāṇena na bījaṃ karohi); — 2. ( mfn. ) not producing growth; not fertile; sterile; Vin I 215, 24 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ … phalaṃ paribhuñjituṃ; Sp 1093, 14 : ~an ti taruṇaṃ, yassa bījaṃ na aṅkuraṃ janeti); M I 306, 12 (app eva nām’ etaṃ māluvabījaṃ moro vā gileyya … ~aṃ vā pan’ assā ti); Mp II 210, 11 (apūtīnī ti pūtibhāvena ~-ttaṃ appattāni); Mil 146, 20 (arahato … ~aṃ viññāṇaṃ kataṃ); — dubbīja , n. , poor, sterile seed; S V 380, 3 ; — sabīja , mfn. , having the seed (to produce progress); Vism 185, 1 (Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 206, 16 : vivaṭṭūpanissayakusalabījena ~o); — subīja , n. , good, productive seed; S V 380, 14 ; Ap 113, 9 (~aṃ ropitaṃ mayā); 250, 17 (~aṃ vāpa ropaya, Be so; Ce vāpi; Se suvījaṃ vāpi; Ee sukhī bījaṃ ca ropaya); — see also udakabījaka, ekabījaka ( sv eka ), bīji(n) ( sv eka ).
CPD: a-bīja , mfn. [ ts. ] , seedless, without germinating power, or n. no seed; Vin l 215, 24 (anujānāmi . . . ~aṃ nibbatta-bījaṃ akatakappaṃ phalaṃ pari- bhuñjituṃ; Sp: 'abījan' ti taruṇaṃ, yassa bījaṃ na aṃkuraṃ janeti); ll 109, 27 (aggi-parijitaṃ + ~aṃ, scil. phalaṃ; quoted Sp (lV) 767, 7 ); ~aṃ karohi, Nidd l 434, 6 (= maggañāṇena na-bījaṃ ( so C S e ) a-bīja bīje); — ° -saññi(n) , mfn., considering as a°; Vin lV 35, 17-19 (bīje ~ī . . . abīje ~ī).

abījasaññī.p: [Na+bījasaññī] (ti) CL=9 Abījasaññā+ī] Seed-No Seed-seed not arising-immature seed-perceived as no seed growth. A person who is perceived as having no seed, no seed arising, immature seed, have no seed growth
a: အဗီဇသညာ+ဤ]  အစေ့-မျိုးစေ့-မရှိ-မျိုးစေ့မဖြစ်-အစေ့နုသည်-ဗီဇဂါမ်မဟုတ်-ဟု အမှတ်ရှိသော၊ သူ။
